_readme: Map positions and content vectors for the viewer's Mapa tab. Built by `python tools/similarity.py build` from book-profiles.jsonl - rebuild after every merge. x/y are t-SNE coordinates on 0-1000: nearness is meaningful, distance across the map is not. Presentation only - nothing here may feed an estimate.
_v: Sparse unit vector [[feature, value], ...]: tags weighted by rarity and group, plus genre, form and audience. Author and series are deliberately absent - they shape the layout, not the page's similarity lists. Cosine similarity is the plain dot product.
_tags: [id, English label, Czech label, group]; feature i < len(tags) is tag i.
